description: This file defines the PHP class 'JobSpecification' which extends an abstract file controller, handling file download requests related to job specifications within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving job specification attachments by ID and setting appropriate response headers.

classes.name: JobSpecification
classes.description: Controller class for handling the retrieval and download of job specification attachment files.

methods.name: getJobTitleService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of JobTitleService.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes the incoming request to fetch and serve a job specification attachment based on 'attachId' parameter.
